data.description: Several contract thresholds were significantly relaxed during calibration, indicating potential optimization opportunities: 1) Transaction commits: 100ms->600ms for 100 entities (~5ms/entity due to per-entity disk I/O), 2) Recovery: 100ms->300ms for 1000 entities, 3) Empty commit: 5ms->20ms. Potential optimizations: batch writes to reduce fsync calls, async I/O, write buffering. These are optional improvements - current performance is acceptable but could be better. Only pursue if performance becomes a user concern.
data.title: Consider performance optimizations for relaxed contracts
